{{Top|leg}}
'''''Starlifter''''' was a group of [[Habassa]]n [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that was ambushed by CR90 group [[Thrasher (corvette group)|Thrasher]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] arrived in an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and managed to fend them off. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Frigate/Legends|Frigates]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and [[Hunter (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Hunter'']] would later arrive in an attempt to destroy them but were both destroyed by Farlander and several rebel starfighters, saving the freighters.
